rules: LAB environmental readings must not promote a group to WORKSHOP_VALIDATED.
Synthetic replay validates software semantics only, never production setpoints.
Every promoted group requires a versioned report or telemetry evidence reference.
No commissioning tool may grant actuation authority or write actuator outputs automatically.
Tuning changes remain SHADOW-only until a separate future actuation stage is explicitly authorized.

fan_outputs.objective: Determine NORMAL/BOOST/HIGH/MAX logical fan requests, thermal limits and extract bias for the installed fan/duct/room system.
required_observations: Installed supply/extract fans and ducts in final workshop configuration.
Stable RPM response for representative command levels.
Room airflow/balance assessment; avoid uncontrolled excessive negative or positive pressure.
Indoor temperature response with representative outside/supply-air temperatures.
Observed pollutant-clearance response from normal workshop processes, not artificial LAB interpretation.
completion_criteria: All fan request percentages and thermal limit percentages are explicitly selected.
extract_bias_pct is justified by room balance observations.
Values are replayed through the scenario/matrix suite before promotion.

aero_outputs.objective: Map NORMAL/BOOST/HIGH/MAX to AERO discrete speeds for the real recuperator zone.
required_observations: AERO installed in final room/duct configuration.
Each discrete speed verified as reachable and stable.
Real zone response to normal process load recorded.
completion_criteria: Monotonic speed policy justified by workshop observations.

dynamics.objective: Tune hysteresis, confirmation, minimum hold and decay using real workshop time-series rather than LAB concentrations.
required_observations: Representative PM2.5/VOC/NOx trajectories from actual workshop operation.
Observed rise/decay times during start and end of representative processes.
Evidence that hysteresis prevents chatter without masking meaningful deterioration.
completion_criteria: Recorded replay demonstrates deterministic escalation, hold and recovery without chatter.

fan_sensor_fallback.objective: Select a safe degraded fan request when the zone SEN55 becomes unavailable.
required_observations: Real-room baseline ventilation effect at candidate degraded requests.
Temperature impact and room balance at the candidate request.
Fault/recovery replay proving immediate deterministic transition.
completion_criteria: sensor_fallback_supply_pct and sensor_fallback_extract_pct explicitly selected as one pair.
Fallback is conservative enough for loss of measurement but does not claim BHP safety.

aero_sensor_fallback.objective: Select a deterministic AERO speed when the zone SEN55 becomes unavailable.
required_observations: Real recuperator-zone operation at candidate fallback speed.
Fault/recovery replay.

tacho_confirmation.objective: Confirm the delay used before missing fan feedback becomes a confirmed TACHO fault.
required_observations: Physical 1.0 V and 2.0 V start characterization on both installed local fan channels.
completion_criteria: 4.0 s remains the validated value unless fan hardware or TACHO conditioning changes.

tacho_supply_fallback.objective: Define the degraded pair of supply/extract requests for confirmed SUPPLY feedback failure.
required_observations: Final-room test with supply unavailable or deliberately held at zero while extract response is observed.
Room pressure/balance observation and pollutant-removal implications.
Temperature impact and safe operator recovery procedure.
completion_criteria: Exactly one explicit fallback supply/extract pair selected.
No value copied from another fault mask without separate evidence.

tacho_extract_fallback.objective: Define the degraded pair of supply/extract requests for confirmed EXTRACT feedback failure.
required_observations: Final-room test with extract unavailable or deliberately held at zero while supply response is observed.
Check risk of positive room pressure and contaminant migration.
Temperature impact and safe operator recovery procedure.
completion_criteria: Exactly one explicit fallback supply/extract pair selected.
No value copied from another fault mask without separate evidence.

tacho_both_fallback.objective: Define the emergency logical response when both local fan feedback channels are confirmed failed.
required_observations: Failure-mode review distinguishing true dual fan loss from signal-path faults.
Operator alarm/recovery procedure.
Real-room assessment of the selected command strategy.
completion_criteria: Exactly one explicit fallback supply/extract pair selected.
The choice is documented as an emergency degraded policy, not proof of safe air quality.
